summary: Practise hotel fault triage, room-readiness workflows, asset risk reviews, and utility scorecards. Explore the course and plan your training.
lede: Hospitality facility management coordinates maintenance and asset care to keep guest-facing spaces safe, comfortable, and ready for service. For hotel facilities supervisors, engineering coordinators, and operations leaders, this training develops practical ways to assess guest-disruption risks, prioritize work orders, and coordinate HVAC repairs with room readiness. It also covers asset-condition decisions and utility performance measures, with exercises that produce tools such as fault-triage matrices and continuity plans.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who coordinate hotel engineering work with room availability, guest comfort, and the service demands of accommodation, dining, and events.
prerequisites: Prior experience in hotel, accommodation, or facilities operations is recommended. You should be familiar with common maintenance requests and the coordination of engineering work; coding or programming is not required.
